reg_deadline.en: Register by Monday, October 26, 2026 to still be mailed a ballot. After that, register and vote in person at a voter service and polling center, through Election Day.
reg_deadline.es: Regístrate a más tardar el lunes 26 de octubre de 2026 para que todavía te envíen una boleta por correo. Después de esa fecha, regístrate y vota en persona en un centro de votación y servicio al votante, hasta el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: October 26 - Deadline to register to vote and still be mailed a ballot.
reg_deadline.en_after: The deadline to register and be mailed a ballot was October 26. You can still register and vote in person at a voter service and polling center through 7 p.m. on Election Day.
reg_deadline.es_after: La fecha límite para registrarte y recibir una boleta por correo fue el 26 de octubre. Todavía puedes registrarte y votar en persona en un centro de votación y servicio al votante hasta las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones.

mail_request.notes: Every active voter is mailed a ballot; there is no request deadline.

mail_return.en: Drop box or voter center: by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Mail: October 26 is the last suggested day to mail it. From October 27 on, take it in your signed envelope to a drop box or voter center instead.
mail_return.es: Buzón o centro de votación: a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Correo: el 26 de octubre es el último día sugerido para enviarla. A partir del 27 de octubre, mejor llévala en tu sobre firmado a un buzón o a un centro de votación.
mail_return.quote: Beginning October 27, voters should only return their ballot to a drop box or voter center, or vote in-person.
mail_return.en_after: Drop box or voter center: by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Don't mail it now. Take it in your signed envelope to a drop box or voter center. A postmark doesn't count. Military and overseas voters have a later deadline.
mail_return.es_after: Buzón o centro de votación: a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Ya no la mandes por correo. Llévala en tu sobre firmado a un buzón o a un centro de votación. El matasellos no cuenta. Los votantes militares y en el extranjero tienen una fecha límite posterior.

early_hours.en: Voter service and polling centers are open for in-person voting through 7 p.m. on Election Day, but each location sets its own days and hours. Look yours up at GoVoteColorado.gov before you go.
early_hours.es: Los centros de votación y servicio al votante están abiertos para votar en persona hasta las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, pero cada lugar fija sus propios días y horarios. Búscalo en GoVoteColorado.gov antes de ir.
early_hours.quote: Voters can look up their locations and hours at GoVoteColorado.gov .

cure.en: Signature missing or doesn't match, or an ID copy missing? Fix it by 11:59 p.m. on Thursday, November 12, 2026.
cure.es: ¿Te faltó la firma, no coincide o falta la copia de tu identificación? Corrígelo a más tardar a las 11:59 p. m. del jueves 12 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.en_after: The deadline to fix a mail ballot problem was 11:59 p.m. on Thursday, November 12, 2026.
cure.es_after: La fecha límite para corregir un problema con la boleta por correo fue a las 11:59 p. m. del jueves 12 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.quote: The deadline for you to submit the necessary information is 11:59 PM MT on the eighth day after Election Day. If the eighth day falls on a state or federal holiday, the deadline moves to the following day.
cure.notes: Nov 12 computed: the eighth day after Nov 3 is Nov 11, Veterans Day (federal holiday), so the source moves it to the next day.

in_person.en: Rather vote in person? Go to any voter service and polling center in your county with ID, until 7 p.m. on Election Day. If you vote at a center outside your home county, you only get the statewide races.
in_person.es: ¿Prefieres votar en persona? Ve a cualquier centro de votación y servicio al votante de tu condado con tu identificación, hasta las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. Si votas en un centro fuera de tu condado, solo recibes las contiendas estatales.
in_person.quote: You will only receive a ballot with statewide races if you vote at a voter center outside your home county.

first_time.en: Registered for the first time recently? You may need to send a copy of your ID with your mail ballot. Your county clerk includes instructions with the ballot.
first_time.es: ¿Te registraste por primera vez hace poco? Es posible que tengas que mandar una copia de tu identificación con tu boleta por correo. La oficina electoral de tu condado (county clerk) incluye las instrucciones con la boleta.
first_time.quote: If you recently registered for the first time, you may need to provide a copy of your ID along with your mail ballot.

locator_label.en: Drop boxes and voting locations (Colorado Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Buzones y lugares de votación (Secretaría de Estado de Colorado)

rule.en: Enter your registered address to find drop boxes and voting locations near you. You can return your ballot to any 24-hour drop box in the state.
rule.es: Escribe la dirección donde estás registrado para encontrar buzones y lugares de votación cerca de ti. Puedes devolver tu boleta en cualquier buzón de 24 horas del estado.
rule.quote: You can mail your ballot back to your County Clerk via USPS, or return your ballot to any 24-hour drop box in the state.

en: Colorado driver's license or Colorado ID card
U.S. military ID or veteran ID card with your photo
Government employee ID with your photo (federal, Colorado or local)
Colorado college or university student ID with your photo
Certified copy of your U.S. birth certificate or naturalization papers
A utility bill, bank statement, paycheck, government check or other government document from the last 60 days with your name and address
es: Licencia de conducir o tarjeta de identificación de Colorado
Pasaporte o tarjeta pasaporte de EE. UU.
Identificación militar o de veterano de EE. UU. con tu foto
Credencial de empleado del gobierno con tu foto (federal, de Colorado o local)
Credencial estudiantil con tu foto de una universidad de Colorado
Copia certificada de tu acta de nacimiento de EE. UU. o de tus documentos de naturalización
Un recibo de servicios, estado de cuenta bancario, talón de pago, cheque del gobierno u otro documento del gobierno de los últimos 60 días con tu nombre y dirección
accepted.quote: All voters who vote at the polls must provide identification.

expired.en: Your ID doesn't have to have a photo. If it shows an address, the address must be in Colorado, but it doesn't have to match your voter registration.
expired.es: Tu identificación no tiene que llevar foto. Si muestra una dirección, tiene que ser de Colorado, pero no tiene que coincidir con tu registro de votante.
expired.quote: If you show ID that has an address on it, the address must be in Colorado but it does not have to match your voter registration

who.en: Every active voter is mailed a ballot. Ballots went out October 2 to 9. Didn't get one, or made a mistake, damaged or lost it? Ask your county clerk for a replacement, or vote in person at a voter service and polling center.
who.es: A cada votante activo le envían una boleta por correo. Las boletas se enviaron del 2 al 9 de octubre. ¿No te llegó, o te equivocaste, se dañó o la perdiste? Pide una de reemplazo a la oficina electoral de tu condado, o vota en persona en un centro de votación y servicio al votante.
who.quote: You may request a replacement mail ballot from your county clerk. You may also vote in-person at a voter service and polling center.

witness.en: Sign the envelope when you return your mail ballot. If you're not sure it will arrive in time, drop it off in person.
witness.es: Firma el sobre cuando devuelvas tu boleta por correo. Si no estás seguro de que llegue a tiempo, entrégala en persona.
witness.quote: Be sure to sign the envelope when you return your mail ballot.

cure.en: Signature missing or doesn't match, or an ID copy missing? Your county will send a letter. Fix it by following the letter, or on your phone with Colorado BallotCure, by 11:59 p.m. on Thursday, November 12.
cure.es: ¿Te faltó la firma, no coincide o falta la copia de tu identificación? Tu condado te enviará una carta. Corrígelo siguiendo la carta, o desde tu teléfono con Colorado BallotCure, a más tardar a las 11:59 p. m. del jueves 12 de noviembre.
cure.quote: The deadline for you to submit the necessary information is 11:59 PM MT on the eighth day after Election Day. If the eighth day falls on a state or federal holiday, the deadline moves to the following day.
cure.notes: Nov 12 computed: the eighth day after Nov 3 is Nov 11, Veterans Day (federal holiday), so the source moves it to the next day.
cure.en_after: The deadline to fix a mail ballot problem was 11:59 p.m. on Thursday, November 12, 2026.
cure.es_after: La fecha límite para corregir un problema con la boleta por correo fue a las 11:59 p. m. del jueves 12 de noviembre de 2026.

dropbox.en: Drop boxes are open 24/7 and under video surveillance. A team of election judges from both parties collects the ballots regularly. Get yours in by 7 p.m. on Election Day.
dropbox.es: Los buzones están abiertos las 24 horas, todos los días, y tienen vigilancia por video. Un equipo de jueces electorales de ambos partidos recoge las boletas con regularidad. Deja la tuya a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones.
dropbox.quote: Drop-box locations are open and are under video surveillance 24/7.

gear.notes: The 100-foot electioneering rule (C.R.S. 1-13-714) was seen only on a Douglas County page and secondary sources; no SOS page or statute text was read.

phone.en: Colorado law lets you show your own voted ballot to anyone, including in a photo you post, as long as it isn't part of an election crime. That covers a mail ballot at home. At a voter center, the county clerk can limit photos, so ask an election judge before you take one there.
phone.es: La ley de Colorado te permite mostrar tu propia boleta votada a cualquier persona, también en una foto que publiques, siempre que no sea parte de un delito electoral. Eso incluye una boleta por correo en casa. En un centro de votación, el secretario del condado (county clerk) puede limitar las fotos, así que pregunta a un juez electoral antes de tomar una ahí.
phone.quote: ANY VOTER MAY SHOW HIS OR HER VOTED BALLOT TO ANY OTHER PERSON AS LONG AS THE DISCLOSURE IS NOT UNDERTAKEN IN FURTHERANCE OF ANY ELECTION VIOLATION PROSCRIBED IN THIS ARTICLE 13.
phone.notes: HB17-1014 session law, amending C.R.S. 1-13-712(1). Same act, (1)(d) and the 31-10-1517 twin: disclosure at a voter service and polling center is subject to the clerk's power to place 'REASONABLE RESTRICTIONS ON THE USE OF PHOTOGRAPHY'. Read 2026-10-28.

line.en: In line at a voter center or a drop box by 7 p.m. on Election Day? Stay put. You can vote, and your ballot will be counted.
line.es: ¿Estás en la fila de un centro de votación o de un buzón a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones? No te salgas. Puedes votar y tu boleta se contará.
line.quote: If you are in line to cast a ballot at a voter center or a drop box by 7:00 p.m. on Election Day, you can vote and it will be counted.

tradition.en: Colorado's Secretary of State runs a digital "I Voted" sticker contest for high school students. The 2026 winner is Halle, a senior at Pine Creek High School in Colorado Springs. Her design shows Blucifer, the blue mustang sculpture by Luis A. Jimenez, Jr. outside Denver International Airport.
tradition.es: La Secretaría de Estado de Colorado organiza un concurso de stickers digitales de "I Voted" para estudiantes de preparatoria. La ganadora de 2026 es Halle, estudiante de último año en Pine Creek High School, en Colorado Springs. Su diseño muestra a Blucifer, la escultura del mustang azul de Luis A. Jimenez, Jr. que está afuera del Aeropuerto Internacional de Denver.
tradition.quote: Today, Secretary of State Jena Griswold announced Pine Creek High School Senior Halle G. as the winner of Colorado's 2026 "I Voted" Digital Sticker Design Contest.
tradition.notes: Student: first name, school and town only. The release gives 'Halle G.' and 'Halle lives in Colorado Springs'; the surname initial is dropped here. The old 'staff pick the winner by popular vote' line was removed; not rechecked against the contest rules.

mail.en: Sign up for BallotTrax. Once your ballot is accepted, it sends you the 2026 Blucifer "I Voted" digital sticker to share.
mail.es: Inscríbete en BallotTrax. Cuando acepten tu boleta, BallotTrax te envía el sticker digital de "I Voted" de Blucifer de 2026 para compartir.
mail.quote: Voters who get updates via BallotTrax will receive this special Blucifer 'I Voted' digital sticker after their ballot has been accepted.

early.en: In Garfield County, yes, while supplies last: a limited special edition "I Voted" sticker for the nation's 250th and Colorado's 150th anniversaries is at ballot drop boxes and vote centers.
early.es: En el condado de Garfield, sí, mientras haya: en los buzones de entrega y los centros de votación hay un sticker especial de edición limitada de "I Voted" por los 250 años del país y los 150 de Colorado.
early.quote: available at ballot drop boxes and vote centers while supplies last

more.en: Look in your ballot packet. Six students drew this year's stickers, from Mia, a 3rd grader at the Academy for Advanced and Creative Learning, to Olivia, an 11th grader at Pine Creek High School. The county put the winning designs in every ballot packet it mailed to active voters on October 5.
more.es: Busca en tu paquete de boleta. Seis estudiantes dibujaron los stickers de este año, desde Mia, de 3.er grado en Academy for Advanced and Creative Learning, hasta Olivia, de 11.º grado en Pine Creek High School. El condado puso los diseños ganadores en cada paquete de boleta que envió por correo a los votantes activos el 5 de octubre.
more.en_after: Six students drew the county's 2026 stickers, from Mia, a 3rd grader at the Academy for Advanced and Creative Learning, to Olivia, an 11th grader at Pine Creek High School. The winning designs were in every ballot packet mailed to active voters on October 5.
more.es_after: Seis estudiantes dibujaron los stickers 2026 del condado, desde Mia, de 3.er grado en Academy for Advanced and Creative Learning, hasta Olivia, de 11.º grado en Pine Creek High School. Los diseños ganadores iban en cada paquete de boleta enviado por correo a los votantes activos el 5 de octubre.
more.quote: The winning sticker designs will be included in all election ballot packets sent to active, registered voters Monday, October 5.
more.notes: El Paso County Clerk and Recorder news, Sept 29, 2026, headline 'I Voted sticker design winners announced for 2026 General Election'; six winners grades 3 to 11 named with schools. curl read. Host clerkandrecorder.elpasoco.com added to ALLOW_HOSTS (www.elpasoco.com home title 'Home - El Paso County, Colorado'; clerk home lists the Oct 5, 2026 ballot mailing). Demand 0.

more.en: Look in your ballot envelope. Alyssa of Arvada drew a bighorn sheep with a butterfly, mountains and a sunset, and Marissa, a 7th grader from Littleton, drew a Colorado landscape. Both stickers go in ballot envelopes across the county this November. Ellie, a 4th grader from Golden, drew the Future Voter sticker for kids at vote centers.
more.es: Busca en el sobre de tu boleta. Alyssa, de Arvada, dibujó un borrego cimarrón con una mariposa, montañas y un atardecer, y Marissa, de 7.º grado en Littleton, dibujó un paisaje de Colorado. Los dos stickers van en los sobres de las boletas de todo el condado este noviembre. Ellie, de 4.º grado en Golden, dibujó el sticker Future Voter para los niños en los centros de votación.
more.en_after: Alyssa of Arvada drew a bighorn sheep with a butterfly, mountains and a sunset, and Marissa, a 7th grader from Littleton, drew a Colorado landscape. Both stickers went in ballot envelopes across the county for November 3, 2026. Ellie, a 4th grader from Golden, drew the Future Voter sticker for kids.
more.es_after: Alyssa, de Arvada, dibujó un borrego cimarrón con una mariposa, montañas y un atardecer, y Marissa, de 7.º grado en Littleton, dibujó un paisaje de Colorado. Los dos stickers fueron en los sobres de las boletas de todo el condado para el 3 de noviembre de 2026. Ellie, de 4.º grado en Golden, dibujó el sticker Future Voter para los niños.
more.quote: Marissa's design, along with Alyssa’s, will be included in ballot envelopes across the county this November, so keep an eye out for their artwork!
more.notes: Jefferson County CO Elections news flash, posted March 23, 2026 ('Celebrating Our I Voted Sticker Design Contest Winners'); Future Voter: 'Her sticker will be shared with kids across the county at community events and vote centers'. curl read. Demand 0.

more.en: Kylie of Berthoud High School won the 2026 contest with nearly 2,500 community votes, cast by ranked choice. Kylie's sticker, printed on the voter instructions in your mail ballot, puts colorful I VOTED letters over mountains at sunset, a lake and columbines, ringed by the county's towns. Finalists' stickers are at vote centers while supplies last.
more.es: Kylie, de Berthoud High School, ganó el concurso 2026 con casi 2,500 votos de la comunidad, emitidos por voto preferencial. El sticker de Kylie, impreso en las instrucciones que vienen con tu boleta por correo, pone letras de colores que dicen I VOTED sobre montañas al atardecer, un lago y aguileñas, rodeadas por los nombres de los pueblos del condado. Los stickers de los finalistas están en los centros de votación mientras duren.
more.en_after: Kylie of Berthoud High School won the 2026 contest with nearly 2,500 community votes, cast by ranked choice. Kylie's sticker, printed on the voter instructions in mail ballots, put colorful I VOTED letters over mountains at sunset, a lake and columbines, ringed by the county's towns. Finalists' stickers were at vote centers while supplies lasted.
more.es_after: Kylie, de Berthoud High School, ganó el concurso 2026 con casi 2,500 votos de la comunidad, emitidos por voto preferencial. El sticker de Kylie, impreso en las instrucciones de las boletas por correo, ponía letras de colores que dicen I VOTED sobre montañas al atardecer, un lago y aguileñas, rodeadas por los nombres de los pueblos del condado. Los stickers de los finalistas estuvieron en los centros de votación mientras duraron.
more.quote: Kylie's sticker will be included on your voter instructions with your mail ballot. Finalist stickers will be available at vote centers across Larimer County starting October 19 while supplies last.
more.notes: Larimer County Clerk and Recorder contest page, read in Chrome (curl gets a 403 challenge). 'winner of our I Voted Sticker Contest for 2026'; ranked choice voting explained on the page. Design described from the winning image on the page (looked at): round, I VOTED in colored letters over mountains at sunset, lake, columbines, an elk; ring lists Berthoud, Loveland, Fort Collins, Wellington, Estes Park, Johnstown, Timnath, Windsor, EST. 1861. Demand 0.

more.en: Four students drew the county's 2026 I Voted stickers: Alayna of New Emerson Elementary, Rhett and Jacob of Independence Academy, and Amora of Grand Junction High School, the contest's first high school winner. More than 175 students entered, and the public voted for the winners.
more.es: Cuatro estudiantes dibujaron los stickers I Voted 2026 del condado: Alayna, de New Emerson Elementary; Rhett y Jacob, de Independence Academy; y Amora, de Grand Junction High School. Es la primera vez que gana alguien de preparatoria. Participaron más de 175 estudiantes, y el público votó por los ganadores.
more.en_after: Four students drew the county's 2026 I Voted stickers: Alayna of New Emerson Elementary, Rhett and Jacob of Independence Academy, and Amora of Grand Junction High School, the contest's first high school winner. More than 175 students entered, and the public voted for the winners.
more.es_after: Cuatro estudiantes dibujaron los stickers I Voted 2026 del condado: Alayna, de New Emerson Elementary; Rhett y Jacob, de Independence Academy; y Amora, de Grand Junction High School. Es la primera vez que gana alguien de preparatoria. Participaron más de 175 estudiantes, y el público votó por los ganadores.
more.quote: Their artwork will be featured on official “I Voted” stickers distributed during the 2026 election season.
more.notes: Mesa County news, Jan 14, 2026; winners list also in the Jan 8 release (elections-announce-winners-2026-i-voted-sticker-contest). 'Wilson is the first high school student to win the contest.' curl read. Demand 0.

provisional.en: You vote one when your eligibility can't be confirmed, for example if you register on Election Day without ID that can be verified. Not on the list? You can register and vote at a voter service and polling center through Election Day. A provisional ballot counts once officials confirm you can vote, but not if you vote it in the wrong county. Your receipt tells you how to check it.
provisional.es: Votas con una cuando no se puede confirmar si tienes derecho a votar, por ejemplo, si te registras el Día de las Elecciones sin una identificación que se pueda verificar. ¿No estás en la lista? Puedes registrarte y votar en un centro de votación y servicio al votante hasta el Día de las Elecciones. Una boleta provisional cuenta cuando los funcionarios confirman que puedes votar, pero no si la votas en el condado equivocado. Tu comprobante te dice cómo revisarla.
provisional.quote: Your provisional ballot is counted if you complete the provisional ballot affidavit and the election official confirms your eligibility to vote. Note: Your provisional ballot will NOT count if you vote in the wrong county, and choose to vote a provisional ballot rather than vote in the correct county. ... The election judge will give you a receipt when you cast a provisional ballot. This receipt specifies how you determine the status of your provisional ballot.
provisional.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Election Day registration and the ID case: coloradosos.gov/pubs/elections/FAQs/ElectionDay.html Q8 ('If you try to register to vote on Election Day, but do not have verifiable identification, you may vote a provisional ballot.') and the reg FAQ. Replaces: If you register on Election Day but don't have ID that can be verified, you can vote a provisional ballot. After Election Day, election officials check that you're eligible, and if you are, it's counted.

line.en: You can still vote. Everyone in line at their polling location by 7 p.m. gets to vote, no matter how long it takes.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Toda persona que esté en la fila de su lugar de votación a las 7 p. m. puede votar, sin importar cuánto tarde.
line.quote: Voters who are in line at their polling location by 7:00 PM are allowed to vote no matter how long it takes for each person to cast his or her ballot.

track.en: Sign up for BallotTrax at ballottrax.coloradosos.gov to follow your ballot from sent to accepted. You can also log in to your voter record at GoVoteColorado.gov to see whether your ballot was mailed.
track.es: Regístrate en BallotTrax en ballottrax.coloradosos.gov para seguir tu boleta desde que la envían hasta que la aceptan. También puedes entrar a tu registro de votante en GoVoteColorado.gov para ver si ya te enviaron la boleta.
track.quote: sign up for BallotTrax, a system that will allow you to track your ballot from sent to accepted.

late_mail.en: Postmarks don't count in Colorado. Your ballot has to be in your county clerk's hands by 7 p.m. on Election Day, so in the last week, use a drop box or voter center.
late_mail.es: En Colorado el matasellos no cuenta. Tu boleta tiene que estar en manos de la oficina electoral de tu condado a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, así que en la última semana usa un buzón o un centro de votación.
late_mail.quote: Postmarks do not count; ballots must be in the hands of the county clerk by 7:00 PM on Election Day in order to be counted.

problem.en: Ask a poll worker first. For anything they can't fix, call your county clerk or the Colorado Secretary of State's elections office at 303-894-2200.
problem.es: Primero pregúntale a un trabajador electoral. Si no lo puede resolver, llama a la secretaría de tu condado (county clerk) o a la oficina de elecciones de la Secretaría de Estado de Colorado al 303-894-2200.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on coloradosos.gov and sos.state.co.us with curl: September 23, 2026 general election press release (ballots mailed October 2 to 9, drop boxes open by October 12, voter centers by October 19, October 26 registration-by-mail and suggested mail-back date, October 27 hand-delivery advice), Election Day FAQ, Mail Ballots FAQ, Acceptable Forms of Identification, Know Your Voting Rights booklet (updated July 20, 2026), GoVoteColorado home, Where do I drop off my ballot (VIP), I Voted digital sticker contest. faq.late_mail says 'in the last week' to match the press release's October 27 advice. The ID list is condensed from the SOS list (pilot's license, Division of Youth Services ID and facility verifications left off); IDs issued under Part 5 of Article 2 of Title 42 are not accepted. Not found on a current official page: signature cure deadline, electioneering and clothing rule, phone rule, voter center hours, a statewide county clerk directory URL. mail.who's 'Ballots went out October 2 to 9' is from the press release ('Colorado's County Clerks will mail ballots via the Postal Service to every active voter between October 2 and October 9'); the rest of that fact is from the Mail Ballots FAQ.

hours.en: In-person voting is open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Puedes votar en persona de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: In-person voting on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, will be available from 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM.
